EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7

Divisional Secretary of Nuwaragampalatha East have by declare under section 7 of the land acquisition act that the land described below is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that act.

Description of the land to be acquired: Allotments of lands within the boundaries mentioned below in extent of 0.0675 Hectare depicted block No from 3815 to 3825 in the plan dated 30.12.2015 prepared by the Surveyor General situated at final town Plan No. 03 of new town Anuradhapura in NuwaragamKorale Minor Division of Nuwaragampalatha East Divisional Secretariat of Anuradhapura District in the North Central Province 1.
